questions.title: Highest Mean (Average) Elevation
questions.current_disclaimer: Statewide mean elevation above sea level, per USGS reference values. Some Plains states rank surprisingly high because their western edges climb toward the Rockies.

questions.title: Most National Parks
questions.current_disclaimer: 'National Park' is a specific NPS designation — the broader 'National Park System' includes 400+ units (monuments, seashores, historic sites) but the traditional 'National Park' title is much rarer. Excludes national monuments, historic sites, seashores, and recreation areas.

questions.title: Most National Forest Acreage
questions.current_disclaimer: National Forest acreage differs from BLM land — the Forest Service manages ~193M acres nationally.

questions.title: Snowiest States (Average Annual Snowfall)
questions.current_disclaimer: Statewide average annual snowfall, averaged across the entire state's land area (NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals). Statewide averages differ substantially from 'snowiest cities' rankings because of how snowfall varies within a state.

questions.title: Highest Average Annual Temperature
questions.current_disclaimer: Statewide average annual mean temperature (Fahrenheit), NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals, averaged across the entire state's land area. Includes both non-contiguous states.

questions.title: Highest Adult Obesity Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Percent of adults (18+) with BMI >= 30 based on self-reported height/weight.

questions.title: Highest Adult Smoking Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Percent of adults (18+) who currently smoke cigarettes every day or some days.

questions.title: Highest Opioid Overdose Death Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Age-adjusted deaths involving any opioid per 100,000 population, 2021.

questions.title: Highest Suicide Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Age-adjusted suicide deaths per 100,000 population, 2021.

questions.title: Highest Uninsured Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Percent of nonelderly population without health insurance coverage.

questions.title: Highest Renewable Electricity Share
questions.current_disclaimer: Renewables include hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, biomass. Percent of total in-state generation.

questions.title: Largest Solar Electricity Generation
questions.current_disclaimer: Total utility-scale solar PV generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023.

questions.title: Largest Wind Electricity Generation
questions.current_disclaimer: Total wind electricity generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023.

questions.title: Highest CO2 Emissions Per Capita
questions.current_disclaimer: Metric tons of energy-related CO2 emissions per resident, 2021.

questions.title: Highest Presidential Winning Margin, 2024 Election
questions.current_disclaimer: Margin = winner percentage minus runner-up percentage.

questions.title: Largest Wine Production
questions.current_disclaimer: California is deliberately excluded to make the ranking competitive; measured in gallons produced.

questions.title: Largest Federal Workforce per Capita
questions.current_disclaimer: Federal civilian executive-branch employees per 10,000 residents; excludes military and postal service.

questions.title: Highest Violent Crime Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Violent crime = murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault. Per 100,000 population.

questions.title: Highest Median Rent
questions.current_disclaimer: Median gross rent (contract rent plus utilities) for renter-occupied housing units.

questions.title: Most Highway Miles per Capita
questions.current_disclaimer: All public roads (rural + urban, all functional classes) divided by state population, expressed per 1,000 residents.
